attempted_claim: Can one prove the Motohashi–Pintz–Zhang estimate MPZ^(4)[varpi,delta] for every fixed varpi, delta > 0 satisfying 1080 varpi + 330 delta < 13, by establishing the required uniform square-root cancellation for the specific four-dimensional finite-field exponential sum arising in the Type-I analysis of Polymath8a?
decisive_failure: The lane fetched and inspected Polymath8a arXiv:1402.0811v3 (Sections 2, 5, 6, 8) and ran bounded brute-force complete-sum checks for small primes and one composite modulus; it did not attempt a full re-derivation of the Type-I dispersion argument or a new averaging architecture, and all negative conclusions are scoped to the uniform single-sum reading of the target as stated.
